decisionTiming: User requested all joint air subsets 1/2/12. Keep identical architecture, optimizer, losses, seed, preprocessing and gates; no hyperparameter tuning. Retrospective training on air2 after old-model air2 evaluation.
input: Background-subtracted Bx, By, Bz only. Training: row before/after linear correction. Live/test: preceding baseline only, live causal 0.12s component median. No target, pose, height, row, time or Pencil IMU input.
representatives: Four correlated representatives per placement, identical extraction to B: whole trimmed hold and three causal windows. They stay together in every split.
output: Linear centered XY in 25mm units; contact logit, sigmoid score. Contact=1, air=0.
loss: Class-balanced mean of 0.5*(XY error in 25mm units)^2 sum + 0.2*binary cross entropy with logits, plus 0.5*l2*sum(weight^2). Both tasks update both shared hidden layers.
optimizer: full-batch Adam, beta1=0.9 beta2=0.999 epsilon=1e-8, total gradient norm clipped to 5
supportGate: Distance to nearest training magnetic representative <= max(3uT, 5*maximum training hold RMS). Used only to abstain, not to choose height or XY. Signal >= max(3uT, 0.2*minimum training vector magnitude). XY outside [-0.05,1.05] is rejected without clipping.
evaluation: Five whole-row folds; final fit contact13 + air2 only. Evaluate final C2 on held-out air1 retrospectively, with no air1 trials in training. Compare 1/2/12 on both passes, clearly separating replay and held-out pass.
limitations: Only two air passes; reverse pass evaluation is retrospective after inspecting both datasets. No arbitrary pose/height validation. C12 has no independent pass; C2 excludes all air1 trials.
